configure.title: Reasons offered after No
configure.description: Readers may pick any number. Leave empty to offer none

properties.title: Id
properties.description: Lower-case letters, numbers and dashes. Keep it once responses use it

configure.title: Keep feedback anonymous
configure.description: On: nothing about the sender is kept. Off: feedback from signed-in people is stored with their name; visitors stay anonymous

configure.title: Show at the end of every page
configure.description: Off: only where an author places the Page feedback block. Each page's settings can hide it

configure.title: Keep feedback in the site's Insights
configure.description: Stored with the site's data on this server and listed under Insights for editors

configure.title: Send each response to a webhook
Webhook address
configure.description: An https address that receives a JSON summary of each response

configure.title: Webhook secret
configure.description: Optional. Sent in the header below so the receiver can tell the message came from this site. Stored on the server, sent only to the webhook address

configure.title: Webhook secret header
configure.description: The request header that carries the secret

configure.title: Include the comment text in the webhook
configure.description: Off: the webhook only says whether a comment was left

configure.title: Which responses are sent on
configure.description: Applies to the webhook and to plugins that notify people. Insights always keeps every response

configure.title: Who is notified
configure.description: Roles, separated by commas. Passed to plugins that notify people (page-feedback.after.submit); this plugin sends no email itself

configure.title: Delete feedback after (days)
configure.description: 0 keeps feedback until someone deletes it

configure.title: Most responses per hour
configure.description: A flood guard for the whole site, counted without recording who sent what. 0 turns it off
